frames: c7/S3.1/Quick add · a sheet, from the Ledger tab

deviations.what: c7 S3.1 *Quick add · a sheet, from the Ledger tab* (and its duplicate na/S3.1): the app's sheet is a type picker — 'Add an account' / 'What kind of account?' over a two-column grid of seven types (Bank, Cash, Credit card, Someone I owe, Someone who owes me, Expense category, Income category) and a Cancel link; the frame draws a search-first picker — a focused search field ('Langar'), a strip of recent-account chips (Gollak Cash, Trust SBI, Electricity, Granthi Honorarium…), a dashed-box '+ Create ‘Langar’ A/C' row, then the matching accounts as rows with a square icon, the name over its class ('category') and its balance ('₹2,34,000 Dr', '₹0')
deviations.reason: [screen] — 13 §3.2 row S3.1 calls this the same component as the entry flow's picker (design S2-C) in a sheet presentation; the app built a separate type-first create sheet. Behaviour to keep from 07 §6 / 02 §4 🔒: a new account asks for its opening balance at creation (the app's second step) — the frame's create row must still lead there
deviations.authority: 13 §3.2 row S3.1; 02 §4 🔒 (every new account asks for its opening balance at creation); ADR 2026-10-05 §1
